scope: NASA EONET curated natural events (date-paged), USGS M5.5+ earthquakes, CISA published advisories, and platform provider-status incidents, each from their own documented feed where available; NOT all disasters or cyberattacks

nasa-eonet.caveat: NASA curated event metadata. All 120-day date windows retrieved without hitting result caps; still NOT a global disaster census.

usgs.caveat: USGS global M5.5+ earthquakes; not the number of damaging disasters.

cisa-advisories.caveat: Government advisories by publication date; not a confirmed attack census.

cloudflare-status.caveat: Cloudflare service-status incidents only. Excludes other providers, and no malicious cause is assumed.

github-status.caveat: GitHub official status incidents; latest 50 only, not all world disruptions.

anthropic-status.caveat: Anthropic official status incidents; latest 50 only, not all world disruptions.

openai-status.caveat: OpenAI official status incidents; latest 50 only, not all world disruptions.

vercel-status.caveat: Vercel official status incidents; latest 50 only, not all world disruptions.

npm-status.caveat: npm official status incidents; latest 50 only, not all world disruptions.
